comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD disclose their net cash used in investing activities for fiscal 2024 and identify similar primary drivers, specifically purchases of short-term investments and capital expenditures (property and equipment). AMD explicitly quantifies its 2024 cash used in investing activities as $1.1 billion, detailing $1.5 billion in short-term investment purchases and $636 million in property and equipment purchases. In contrast, Intel highlights higher proceeds from government incentives and higher equity investment sales as favorable drivers, which are not explicitly highlighted as key positive drivers in AMD's summary, although AMD does report proceeds from maturities and sales of short-term investments.
